name: Ford Mustang Mach-E (Mcity) - PROVISIONAL (template/spec values, not measured)
_notes: mass/lf/lr/Iz: from scale or spec sheet (Step 0). tau/delay: fit_steering.py. steering_ratio/Cf/Cr: fit_vehicle.py. weights copied from mkz.json so the MachE tables keep the MKZ tuning feel. 2026-10-20: PROVISIONAL tables generated from template values (no system-ID drives yet). r de-tuned: withoutdelay 16 (stable to ~25 m/s with 0.2 s delay), withdelay 4 (damping >=0.33 to 30 m/s). Regenerate after Tests 1-3. 2026-10-26: first car test (highway route, <=8.3 m/s): lateral correction too weak (ey drifted to +1.6 m -> path-departure stop) and a steady -0.035 rad heading bias. withdelay retuned to r=1, q_ey x4 (k_ey ~ the old MKZ x1.4 setup; damping >=0.33 up to 15 m/s, thin above), heading_offset back to -0.03. 2026-10-26 (2nd drive): lateral good (|ey|~0.05 m on straights) but steering felt aggressive -> q_ey x2 (from x4), plus steer_rate_limit in the launch.

_history.change: withdelay r 4->1, q_ey x4 after first car test
withdelay q_ey x4 -> x2 (smoother steering) after 2nd drive
